  • Classes
    Class
    Description
    ClassAdapter
    Adapter: converts BlueJ's class events into the plugin's class events.
    CompileAdapter
    Adapter: converts BlueJ's compile events into EventType.COMPILE_SUCCESS and EventType.COMPILE_ERROR events.
    EditorActivityPoller
    Every few seconds, reads the text length of each open editor and passes the numbers to the ActivityMonitor, which decides what counts as an edit or idle time.
    ExportMenuGenerator
    Adds the option/button "Export Telemetry Report" to BlueJ's Tools menu, so the student can save the JSON and PDF for the session so far at any time.
    ExportPackageListener
    Starts a session when a project opens, and saves the session's JSON and PDF into the project's folder when it closes.
    InvocationAdapter
    Adapter: converts BlueJ's "method call finished" events (when the student runs a method from BlueJ's interface) into EventType.RUN_FINISHED or EventType.RUN_EXCEPTION events.
    MethodAdapter
    Adapter: after each successful compile the student starts, asks BlueJ for the compiled classes' methods and publishes a EventType.METHOD_ADDED event for each new one.
    PackageAdapter
    Adapter: converts BlueJ's package events into EventType.PROJECT_OPENED and EventType.PROJECT_CLOSED events.
    StudentIdPreferences
    Adds a "Telemetry student ID" text input box to BlueJ's Tools -> Preferences -> Extensions panel.
